gi._about: Bounced light (2026-10-09, Josh: as CORICORI) -- the same settings: the room measured alike (median bounce 0.07 vs 0.11, 57% of surfaces in direct torchlight vs 68%). strength = how much of it; ambient = the room's flat level while it is on, as a share of it; albedo 2.2 = the textures' painted-in lighting made up for; spacing/rays/bounces = the bake.

steam._note: Round 7 (Josh, SPAROOM/4): the class spa steam (size 40 puffs, 40/s) was too large; small sharply shaped wisps, more of them

drips._about: Round 15 (Josh, SPAROOM/2): droplets from above that ring the water where they land. There is no ceiling over the pool, so they start fromDark units above the eye; rate a second, within radius of the player; ripples = how strongly a landing rings the surface.

waterMist._about: Room Review SPAROOM/8 (Josh, 2026-10-09): a subtle teal mist along the edges of the top of the water, the water's colour but lighter, alongside the dark fine steam. rate = puffs a second; size/life/rise; alpha = how solid; inset = how far in over the water they start; drift.

water._about: glow = the light's colour under the water; glowPower = how bright the surface glows; glowBase = the even part, lights = lamps under it (x, z in room units; radius; power on top of glowBase); dots = how much the glow brightens the texture's own specks; shine = reflection strength (x Fresnel: strong at a glance, little looking straight down), f0 = reflection looking straight down; spec = glints of the flashlight and placed lights; distort = how far the ripples bend the reflection (pixels); ripple slope/size/speed; caustics strength (the moving lines) + fill (the even light) on the walls above, fading over 'height' units, size = the web's cell size.
water._lightSpec: Round 6 (Josh, SPAROOM/4): the torches' glint on the water, softened and warm (colour squared, ~1/4 of round 5's); 1 = this, lower = fainter
water._distort: Round 15 (Josh, SPAROOM/2): more distortion (was 60) and ripple (slope 0.15 -> 0.22)
water._noLight: Round 5 (Josh): the light off the water stays out of the three hallways (tunnel01/09-11 south-west, tunnel02-05 east, tunnel06-08/12 north; their floor plans plus 4 units)
